name: Small Jar with Rolled Lip and with Willow-Basket Weave and Boss Décor
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；13th-14th century；Ganzhou ware: light gray stoneware, the unglazed exterior with combed and applique decoration, the unglazed neck with beads of pearly white glaze to form the bosses, the interior with russet-surfaced dark brown glaze. From the kilns at Qili Ganzhou, Jiangxi province
